senses.sense_definition: Iets (zoals een bericht, klacht of document) doorsturen naar een andere instantie of persoon.

examples.text: De ombudsman gaat klachten over de politie <w>doorgeleiden</w> naar de onafhankelijke klachtencommissie.

target_lang_translations.en: The ombudsman is going to <w>forward</w> complaints about the police to the independent complaints committee.

examples.text: Zij zal de ontvangen documenten direct naar de juiste afdeling <w>doorgeleiden</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: She will <w>pass</w> the received documents <w>on</w> to the correct department immediately.

target_lang_definitions.en: To forward or pass on something (such as a message, complaint, or document) to another authority or person.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to send a document or message to another recipient
to transmit information or complaints to someone else
to direct a matter or complaint to an authority for decision

senses.sense_definition: Een persoon ergens doorheen helpen of begeleiden.

examples.text: De gids hielp om de toeristen veilig door de smalle bergpas te <w>doorgeleiden</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: The guide helped to <w>guide</w> the tourists safely <w>through</w> the narrow mountain pass.

examples.text: Het is de taak van de douane om reizigers snel door de controle te <w>doorgeleiden</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: It is the duty of customs to <w>usher</w> travelers <w>through</w> the checkpoint quickly.

target_lang_definitions.en: To guide or help a person through a specific passage, area, or process.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to lead someone through a physical passage or process
to accompany someone safely through an area
to conduct or show someone the way through
